_note: Persists summoner spell mode preference across sessions.
_by_champ_note: RC2 E6 remember-last-used: by_champ[MODE_TAG][champion display name] = [spell1_id, spell2_id]. MODE_TAG is SR/ARAM/ARENA/BRAWL/TFT. RuneWriter pushes this remembered pair on the next lock of that champ+mode (highest over the generic default); a manual in-champ-select spell change records here automatically.
